# MeshLink 2.0 API and local configuration

MeshLink has four distinct external service integrations. None is required for the offline BLE/SOS path.

## Android `local.properties`

Create or edit the project-root `local.properties` file (Android Studio creates `sdk.dir`). Keep it local and never commit it.

```properties
# Keep the sdk.dir line generated by Android Studio; do not copy a placeholder path.

gnani.api.key=YOUR_GNANI_API_KEY_ID
evon.base.url=https://YOUR_TLS_INFERENCE_HOST/v1
evon.model=gnani/gnani-evon-v3.3-30B-A3B
evon.api.key=YOUR_OPTIONAL_INFERENCE_BEARER_TOKEN
translation.api.key=YOUR_GOOGLE_CLOUD_TRANSLATION_API_KEY
cloud.api.base.url=https://YOUR_PUBLIC_MESHLINK_API_HOST
```

Only configure services you have actually provisioned. The app intentionally treats missing credentials/endpoints as unavailable.

## Prisma speech-to-text

- Endpoint: `POST https://api.vachana.ai/stt/v3`
- Authentication header: `X-API-Key-ID`
- Multipart fields: `audio_file`, `language_code`, `format=transcribe`
- Supported app locale codes: `bn-IN`, `en-IN`, `gu-IN`, `hi-IN`, `kn-IN`, `ml-IN`, `mr-IN`, `pa-IN`, `ta-IN`, `te-IN`
- Local recording is capped at 10 seconds; imported audio is checked against the app's 30-second / 25 MB client guardrails.

## Evon inference

Evon is not provided by the Prisma/Timbre API key. Provision a separate HTTPS server that exposes an OpenAI-compatible `POST /v1/chat/completions` endpoint. Configure `evon.base.url` with the `/v1` prefix and set `evon.model` to the served model alias. `evon.api.key` is optional and sent as a Bearer token if configured. The client rejects non-HTTPS base URLs.

## Google Cloud Translation Basic v2

Enable Cloud Translation API and billing in a Google Cloud project. Restrict the API key to the Translation API and apply suitable usage restrictions. Configure `translation.api.key`. The app uses `POST https://translation.googleapis.com/language/translate/v2`; translated output is stored separately from the original transcript. Translation is a separate service, not an Evon capability claim.

## Timbre text-to-speech

- Endpoint: `POST https://api.vachana.ai/api/v1/tts/inference`
- Authentication header: `X-API-Key-ID`
- Model: `timbre-v2.5`
- Response: raw WAV audio bytes, validated before saving
- Language/voice combinations are restricted to the app's supported catalog.

## MeshLink cloud backend

Set `cloud.api.base.url` to the deployed HTTPS origin, without a trailing slash. Backend configuration, PostgreSQL, TLS, responder account provisioning and retention instructions are in [`../backend/README.md`](../backend/README.md). The Android app stores its short-lived bearer token using Android Keystore-backed encryption. The backend is not deployed as part of this source archive.

## Credential handling

- Do not place keys in Kotlin source, XML, Gradle scripts, screenshots or Git history.
- Debug BuildConfig values can be extracted from a debug APK; only use local test credentials there.
- Release BuildConfig provider credentials are empty by design. Do not ship a production client with long-lived provider keys embedded.
- Use a secured backend/proxy for production secret handling and rotate any credential accidentally exposed.
